pre_registration_track.censoring: a continuation that never crosses within L is censored at the last window and ranks above every observed value; the censoring rate prints
pre_registration_track.covariate: seed's t=0 z-distance from the model median centroid
pre_registration_track.hypothesis: strong prose holds the model's continuations in its register longer before they decay to the model's median centroid
pre_registration_track.neutral_pool: own-generated prose (corpora/toll-scenes.json), NEUTRAL_SEEDS seeds x K
pre_registration_track.pilot_may_set: only L, and only from the censoring rate; the label is never consulted, and the pilot's own agreement is not a result
pre_registration_track.primary_statistic: crossover window index — the first window at which distance to the seed's register exceeds distance to the model median
pre_registration_track.secondary_statistic: exponential half-life of r_w - 0.5; DIAGNOSTIC, because a fit is a functional-form assumption and the primary read may not rest on one
pre_registration_track.z_scale: the run's own per-feature population sd over every window in the run; run-dependent, so numbers are not comparable across runs and the scale's digest is recorded
